answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, recorded on a public ledger. A newcomer starts small, like a single opal chip, and only grows its earning power as attested work accumulates. Forging a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand stakes at once, and proven fraud slashes the stake, so an attacker pays real capital per sybil. Honest agents keep their stake safe, like ivory in a vault: untouched while they behave, forfeited the moment they cheat. One mesa of reputation is cheap to build; a mountain range of fakes is not.
